actions.text: Pursuant to the provisions of H. Res. 434, H.R. 3846 is laid on the table.
The Clerk was authorized to correct section numbers, punctuation, and cross references, and to make other necessary technical and conforming corrections in the engrossment of H.R. 3081.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On passage Passed by recorded vote: 282 - 143 (Roll no. 45).
Passed/agreed to in House: On passage Passed by recorded vote: 282 - 143 (Roll no. 45).
On motion to recommit with instructions Failed by recorded vote: 181 - 243 (Roll no. 44). (text: CR H899-900)
The previous question on the motion to recommit with instructions was ordered without objection.

DEBATE - The House proceeded with 10 minutes of debate on the motion to recommit with instructions. The instructions contained in the motion provide for striking sections 2, 3, and 4 from the bill and to insert a new section at the end of the bill setting new guidelines for the minimum wage scale in the Northern Mariana Islands.
Mr. Clay moved to recommit with instructions to Education and Labor.
The previous question was ordered pursuant to the rule.
DEBATE - Pursuant to H. Res. 434 the House proceeded with 30 minutes of debate on the amendment.
DEBATE - The Chair announced that the decision of the House was to consider the bill and the House proceeded with one hour of debate.

Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 3081 and H.R. 3846. H.R. 3081 shall be considered in the House and shall be considered as read. In lieu of the amendment recommended by the Committee on Ways and Means now printed in the bill, the text of H.R. 3832 shall be considered as adopted. Debate shall continue for not to exceed two hours, equally divided and controlled, and there shall be one motion to recommit, with or without instructions. H.R. 3846 shall be considered in the House, shall be considered as read, and shall be debatable for one hour, equally divided and controlled. Specified amendments are in order and consist of those printed in the report of the Committee on Rules accompanying this resolution. There shall be one motion to recommit, with or without instructions. Considered under the provisions of rule H. Res. 434. (consideration: CR H879-902; text of measure as introduced: CR H881-882)
On motion to consider the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 274 - 141 (Roll no. 42).

DEBATE - The Chair noted that the point of order raised by Mr. Largent met the threshold required under the rule and allotted 20 minutes of debate, equally divided and controlled, for the purpose of determining whether or not consideration of the measure will go forward. At the conclusion of debate, the Chair will put the question of consideration of the measure before the House.

Point of order raised by Mr. Largent on the content of the measure. Mr. Largent stated that the bill violated section 425(a) of the Congressional Budget Act of 1974 to the extent that it imposed intra-governmental expenses in the form of an unfunded mandate totaling more than $50 million. The Chair sustained the point of order.
Mr. Goodling called up the bill.
Rule H. Res. 434 passed House.
